A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete, readable 19-page ARLON paper, including Appendices A.1–A.6. Text and rendered pages match apart from the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports original ARLON benchmark results and ablations in Tables 1–3, plus resource measurements and training-data comparisons in appendix Tables 4–5.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original benchmark evaluations, ablations, resource measurements, training-data comparisons and qualitative generation results.

M1.justification: Section 2 retains identical latent VQ-VAE compression, autoregressive modeling, semantic injection, coarser-token training and uncertainty sampling procedures.

E1.justification: Training datasets and evaluation coverage are identical, including VBench evaluations, long-video generation, progressive prompts and appendix video-conditioned examples.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical throughout the main and appendix experiments, including FreeNoise, StreamingT2V and OpenSora-V1.2 in the long-video comparison.

E3.justification: Both versions report identical metrics, training settings, video lengths, resolutions, 100-prompt ablation samples and resource-measurement protocols in Section 4 and Appendix A.

E4.justification: The component ablations, denoising-step analysis, training-data-size study and qualitative failure cases are identical in Sections 4.3–4.4 and Appendix A.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical. Neither version reports repeated-run or seed counts, error bars, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results in Tables 1–5 and qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, ARLON's dynamic-degree scores remain 50.42 in Table 1 and 52.8 in Table 2.

T1.justification: Equations 1–10 and their mathematical definitions are identical, including the diffusion preliminaries in Appendix A.1. No formal assumptions, derivations or proofs change.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical contributions and claims concerning AR-guided diffusion, video quality and dynamics, long-video performance and inference efficiency.

C2.justification: Interpretations of motion, consistency, efficiency and data quality are unchanged. Appendix A.4 retains the same backbone-quality limitation, high-resolution token-length constraint and generation failure discussion.

D1.justification: Architecture specifications, hyperparameters, hardware and timing details in Section 4.1 and Appendix A.2 are identical. The project-page link and PDF hyperlink targets are also unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 3, research-positioning passages and the reference list are identical, with no added or removed cited works.

P1.justification: The sole textual edit updates the first-page arXiv stamp from v2, dated 25 Feb 2025, to v3, dated 15 Apr 2025. Prose, headings and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: All 16 figures and five tables retain identical content, captions, formatting and placement. Page layout is unchanged; the margin-stamp wording update is recorded under P1.

improvement.justification: v3 only updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific content, empirical evidence, explanations, limitations and visual presentation across the main paper and appendices are otherwise identical, establishing no meaningful difference in overall quality.
